احتياطات السلامة

A work permit must be issued and the qualified 
 maintenance staff should carry the suitable safety category

Safety fence with
caution marks surrounding the work area is required.

Wear safety 
and healthy equipment as safety helmet, safety shoes, gloves, ... etc.

The air heater must be isolated mechanically by 
closing inlet and outlet valves.

Be sure the cooling water of the upper and lower bearing is 
closed

Before Isolating the Air Heater Mechanically 
and Electrically
Check any abnormal noise or vibration.

Check any air or flue gases leakage from 
 manholes.
Check the oil level of upper guide bearing.
تحقق من مستوى الزيت لمحمل الدعم السفلي.
Check the oil level of drive unit.

Check the oil level of drive unit for blowing 
 equipment.

Check auxiliary drive in service for a few 
 minutes.

sections.text:
After Isolating the Air Heater Mechanically and 
Electrically

Washing air pre-heater at the cold end and hot 
 end to cleaning it in out the unit until the PH of drain water equal washing 
 water PH= 8

Vent the water cooling system for guide 
 supporting bearing in top bottom end and clean it if needed .

Check sealing clearance according to table No. 1 
 and figure No. 2
Check the basket and changing it if needed

Check the soot blower system in every air heater 
 and spray all nozzle if needed

تحقق من نظام تركيب التنوب t5he في كل سخان هواء 
 ورش كل الفوهة إذا لزم الأمر.

Check the washing system upper and lower every 
 air heater and spray all nozzle if needed.
Check alignment limits for coupling
